# eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets (Data Source)

Retrieves the S3 buckets available to Eon in a restore account. Use this data source to select a bucket for `eon_restore_job` S3 restore destinations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List the S3 buckets available to Eon in a restore account
data "eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets" "demo" {
  restore_account_id = eon_restore_account.aws_disaster_recovery.id
}

output "s3_bucket_names" {
  description = "Names of the S3 buckets available for restore in the account"
  value       = [for bucket in data.eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets.demo.buckets : bucket.bucket_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the restore account.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) List of S3 buckets available in the restore account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_name` (String) Name of the bucket.
- `region_name` (String) Region where the bucket is located.
